cases.note: f6-17 'Trusted HTTPS': the Ciuki page over TLS 1.2 with the fixture CA of the test profile
f6-17 'Certificate refusal': the fixture answers the untrusted.test SNI with a self-signed certificate; no response reaches the browser
f6-17 'HTTP to HTTPS redirect': /upgrade (plain HTTP) redirects to https://fixture.test/cookie, which sets the Secure cookie and lands on /cookie-end over TLS
f6-17 'Cookie over TLS': /cookie-end answers 200 only when the Secure; HttpOnly cookie set by /cookie comes back over TLS (403 otherwise)
f6-17 '64 KiB gzip over TLS': exactly 65,536 decoded bytes delivered to the core

f6-17 'Not ready': now=1 starts the browser before the entropy pool is seeded; the readiness page replaces the fetch (no connection). The tls verdict name arrives with f6-17's CIUKI_TLS_NOT_READY mapping (sdk/netsurf/port/testmode.inc)

fx-11, T23 trial 423b803a: NetSurf on the T23's NIC model (i82559er = e100) fetches the fixture page over plain HTTP. Before fx-11 every connect failed: fcntl(F_SETFL, F_GETFL|O_NONBLOCK) returned EINVAL for a socket (page status=0 tls=none, '[netsurf] fetch ... stage=error errno=22 ... at=connect' on the serial line, no SYN).

fx-11, T23 trial 423b803a: the same over TLS 1.2 with the fixture CA on the e100 model; before fx-11 status=0 tls=error (errno=22 at connect). Serial must show '[net] tcp connect ... established=1' and no fetch stage=error record.
